tasks.title: Fix ESLint Configuration Issues
tasks.description: Resolve all ESLint configuration issues to ensure consistent code quality.
tasks.details: Use ESLint 8.56.0 with TypeScript ESLint parser 6.1.0. Create or update .eslintrc.js to include necessary rules and plugins. Run eslint --fix to automatically fix issues where possible.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that running eslint . returns no errors. Check that the codebase adheres to the defined ESLint rules.

subtasks.title: Identify ESLint Rules
subtasks.description: Research and list the specific ESLint rules required for the project.
subtasks.details: Document the rules and their purposes.

subtasks.title: Identify ESLint Plugins
subtasks.description: Research and list the specific ESLint plugins required for the project.
subtasks.details: Document the plugins and their purposes.

subtasks.title: Update ESLint Configuration File
subtasks.description: Modify the ESLint configuration file to include the identified rules and plugins.
subtasks.details: Ensure the configuration file is correctly formatted and saved.

subtasks.title: Run ESLint to Identify Issues
subtasks.description: Execute ESLint on the project to identify any issues or errors.
subtasks.details: Document the issues found during the ESLint run.

subtasks.title: Verify and Apply Fixes
subtasks.description: Review the issues identified by ESLint and apply the necessary fixes.
subtasks.details: Ensure all issues are resolved and the codebase is clean.

tasks.title: Resolve TypeScript Type Errors
tasks.description: Fix all TypeScript type errors to ensure type safety across the codebase.
tasks.details: Use TypeScript 5.3.3. Run tsc --noEmit to check for type errors. Address each error by either fixing the code or adjusting the types as necessary.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that running tsc --noEmit returns no errors. Ensure that the codebase compiles successfully with TypeScript.

tasks.title: Implement Consistent Code Formatting
tasks.description: Ensure consistent code formatting throughout the codebase.
tasks.details: Use Prettier 3.1.1 with ESLint integration. Create or update .prettierrc to define formatting rules. Run prettier --write . to format the code.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that running prettier --check . returns no errors. Ensure that the codebase adheres to the defined formatting rules.

tasks.title: Remove Deprecated Code Patterns
tasks.description: Identify and remove deprecated code patterns to improve code quality.
tasks.details: Use ESLint with the eslint-plugin-deprecation plugin. Run eslint --fix to automatically fix issues where possible. Manually review and remove deprecated code.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that running eslint . returns no deprecation warnings. Ensure that the codebase no longer uses deprecated patterns.

tasks.title: Resolve Package Version Conflicts
tasks.description: Address package version conflicts to ensure dependency stability.
tasks.details: Use npm-check-updates 16.10.12 to check for outdated packages. Manually resolve version conflicts by updating or downgrading packages as necessary. Use npm ls to check for conflicts.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that running npm ls returns no version conflicts. Ensure that the application builds and runs successfully with the resolved versions.

tasks.title: Update Outdated Dependencies
tasks.description: Update outdated dependencies to their latest versions.
tasks.details: Use npm-check-updates 16.10.12 to identify outdated packages. Update packages to their latest versions using npm install <package>@latest. Test the application thoroughly after each update.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that running npm-check-updates returns no outdated packages. Ensure that the application functions correctly with the updated dependencies.

tasks.title: Fix Build Pipeline Issues
tasks.description: Resolve any issues in the build pipeline to ensure smooth builds.
tasks.details: Review the build scripts in package.json. Address any errors or warnings that occur during the build process. Ensure that the build pipeline runs successfully.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that running npm run build completes successfully. Ensure that the build artifacts are generated correctly.

tasks.title: Implement Proper Dependency Management
tasks.description: Ensure proper management of dependencies to avoid conflicts and vulnerabilities.
tasks.details: Use npm or yarn for dependency management. Create a lockfile (package-lock.json or yarn.lock) to ensure consistent installs. Regularly audit dependencies using npm audit or yarn audit.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that running npm audit or yarn audit returns no vulnerabilities. Ensure that the application builds and runs successfully with the managed dependencies.

tasks.title: Implement Error Boundaries
tasks.description: Add error boundaries to catch and handle errors in React components.
tasks.details: Create an ErrorBoundary component using React's componentDidCatch lifecycle method. Wrap components with the ErrorBoundary to catch errors.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that errors in wrapped components are caught and handled by the ErrorBoundary. Ensure that the application does not crash when an error occurs.

tasks.title: Add Proper Error Logging
tasks.description: Implement proper error logging to track and diagnose issues.
tasks.details: Use a logging library like Winston 3.11.0. Configure Winston to log errors to a file or a monitoring service. Add error logging in critical parts of the application.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that errors are logged correctly. Ensure that the logs contain sufficient information to diagnose issues.

tasks.title: Improve Error Messages
tasks.description: Enhance error messages to provide more context and guidance.
tasks.details: Review existing error messages and improve them to be more descriptive and user-friendly. Ensure that error messages provide clear instructions on how to resolve the issue.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that error messages are clear and informative. Ensure that users can understand and resolve issues based on the error messages.

tasks.title: Add Error Tracking Integration
tasks.description: Integrate an error tracking service to monitor and alert on errors.
tasks.details: Use an error tracking service like Sentry 7.12.0. Configure Sentry to capture and report errors. Add Sentry integration to the application.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that errors are captured and reported by Sentry. Ensure that alerts are triggered for critical errors.

tasks.title: Add Unit Tests for Critical Components
tasks.description: Write unit tests for critical components to ensure their functionality.
tasks.details: Use a testing framework like Jest 29.7.0. Write unit tests for critical components and ensure they cover all edge cases. Use mocking libraries like jest-mock to isolate components.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that unit tests pass for all critical components. Ensure that the tests cover all edge cases and scenarios.

tasks.title: Implement Integration Tests
tasks.description: Create integration tests to ensure components work together correctly.
tasks.details: Use a testing framework like Cypress 13.6.2. Write integration tests to test the interaction between components. Ensure that the tests cover all critical workflows.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that integration tests pass for all critical workflows. Ensure that the tests cover all scenarios where components interact.

tasks.title: Add End-to-End Tests
tasks.description: Implement end-to-end tests to validate the entire application flow.
tasks.details: Use a testing framework like Cypress 13.6.2. Write end-to-end tests to test the entire application flow from start to finish. Ensure that the tests cover all critical user journeys.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that end-to-end tests pass for all critical user journeys. Ensure that the tests cover all scenarios from start to finish.

tasks.title: Set Up Continuous Testing Pipeline
tasks.description: Configure a continuous testing pipeline to automate testing.
tasks.details: Use a CI/CD tool like GitHub Actions. Create workflows to run unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests on each pull request and push to the main branch. Ensure that the pipeline fails if any tests fail.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the continuous testing pipeline runs successfully. Ensure that tests are executed and reported correctly.

tasks.title: Implement Security Best Practices
tasks.description: Ensure the application follows security best practices.
tasks.details: Use security tools like OWASP ZAP or Snyk to scan for vulnerabilities. Implement security headers, input validation, and proper authentication checks. Regularly review and update security practices.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that security scans return no vulnerabilities. Ensure that the application is secure against common attacks.

tasks.title: Add Input Validation
tasks.description: Implement input validation to prevent malicious input.
tasks.details: Use validation libraries like Joi 17.11.0. Add input validation to all user inputs to ensure they meet the expected format and constraints. Handle validation errors gracefully.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that input validation works correctly. Ensure that malicious input is rejected and handled appropriately.

tasks.title: Fix Security Vulnerabilities
tasks.description: Address any identified security vulnerabilities.
tasks.details: Use security tools like OWASP ZAP or Snyk to identify vulnerabilities. Fix identified vulnerabilities by updating dependencies, patching code, or implementing security measures.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that security scans return no vulnerabilities. Ensure that the application is secure against identified threats.

tasks.title: Implement Proper Authentication Checks
tasks.description: Ensure proper authentication checks are in place.
tasks.details: Use authentication libraries like Passport.js 0.6.0. Implement proper authentication checks to ensure only authorized users can access protected routes and resources. Handle authentication errors gracefully.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that authentication checks work correctly. Ensure that unauthorized access is prevented and handled appropriately.

tasks.title: Optimize Bundle Size
tasks.description: Reduce the bundle size to improve load times.
tasks.details: Use tools like Webpack Bundle Analyzer to identify large bundles. Optimize code by splitting large modules, removing unused code, and using tree shaking. Minify assets using tools like UglifyJS or Terser.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the bundle size is reduced. Ensure that the application loads quickly and performs well.

tasks.title: Improve Load Times
tasks.description: Enhance load times to provide a better user experience.
tasks.details: Use techniques like lazy loading, code splitting, and caching to improve load times. Optimize images and other assets to reduce their size. Use a Content Delivery Network (CDN) to serve assets faster.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that load times are improved. Ensure that the application loads quickly and provides a smooth user experience.

tasks.title: Implement Code Splitting
tasks.description: Split code into smaller chunks to improve load times.
tasks.details: Use Webpack's code splitting features to split code into smaller chunks. Dynamically import modules using import() to load them on demand. Ensure that critical code is loaded first.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that code splitting works correctly. Ensure that the application loads quickly and performs well.

tasks.title: Add Performance Monitoring
tasks.description: Monitor application performance to identify and address bottlenecks.
tasks.details: Use performance monitoring tools like New Relic or Datadog. Integrate performance monitoring into the application to track key metrics like load times, response times, and error rates. Set up alerts for performance issues.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that performance monitoring works correctly. Ensure that key metrics are tracked and reported accurately.

tasks.title: Update README
tasks.description: Ensure the README file is up-to-date with the latest information.
tasks.details: Update the README file to include installation instructions, usage examples, and contribution guidelines. Ensure that the README is clear and informative.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the README file is up-to-date and accurate. Ensure that it provides all necessary information for users and contributors.

tasks.title: Add Inline Code Documentation
tasks.description: Document the code inline to improve maintainability.
tasks.details: Add comments and documentation to the code to explain its purpose and functionality. Use JSDoc or TypeScript doc comments to document functions, classes, and modules. Ensure that the documentation is clear and concise.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the code is well-documented. Ensure that the documentation is accurate and up-to-date.

tasks.title: Create API Documentation
tasks.description: Document the API to provide clear and concise information.
tasks.details: Use a documentation tool like Swagger or Postman to create API documentation. Document all API endpoints, request/response formats, and authentication methods. Ensure that the documentation is clear and informative.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the API documentation is accurate and up-to-date. Ensure that it provides all necessary information for developers.

tasks.title: Document Deployment Process
tasks.description: Document the deployment process to ensure smooth deployments.
tasks.details: Document the deployment process, including steps for building, testing, and deploying the application. Include information on environment variables, configuration files, and deployment scripts. Ensure that the documentation is clear and concise.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the deployment documentation is accurate and up-to-date. Ensure that it provides all necessary information for deploying the application.
